SU/SH Series Benchtop Chambers
Premium features for the ultimate in testing flexibility. 
SU/SH Series Benchtop Chambers 
Models
P-200
Options
Compare
Get Pricing
The SH-242 model is in stock and ships in as little as two days.
Are you looking for the smallest chambers possible to get your testing done? Still need all the capabilities of larger chambers, though? This is the model series for you! Available in two sizes, the smaller models are the smallest humidity chambers in the world!
Easy to install and own:
The SU/SH models are small enough be placed underneath a benchtop or on top.
Designed for integration with other test equipment to make a complete test stand.
The smaller models run on standard 115V power enabling easy installation anywhere.
Humidity chambers include a removable water storage tank, avoiding the need for water hook-ups. The tank will last up to a week at 85°C/85% and can be refilled without interrupting the test. (Option for direct water connection is available.)
Extremely quiet operation as low as 52 dba, suitable for quiet labs or offices.
Need help finding the right ESPEC chamber?    Try our chamber selector tool »
 Features for SU/SH Series Benchtop Chambers 
Premium design with a space-saving footprint and quiet operation suitable for offices and small labs
 One 2" diameter cable port on the right side (Note: previous model series also included a standard port on left)
 Removable humidity water tank for SH models (direct water connection optional)
 One adjustable stainless steel shelf
 Temperature (& humidity) output terminals
ESPEC'S Exclusive P-200 Programmer/Controller:
User-friendly touch-screen operation
Three different ‘constant mode’ settings can be saved for single-setting operation
Store eight cycling programs, with up to 99 steps each
Programs may be written on a PC and uploaded via USB
The trend-graph display shows a record of setpoints and actual values
Operation data can be downloaded as needed, or continually, to USB
Pattern Manager Lite PC software for program editing and datalog viewing/exporting, to support USB functionality
Also included is Web Manager remote monitor/control via Ethernet/browser

Big chamber capabilities in a benchtop chamber: The SU/SH benchtop models have the same controller as our larger chambers in a smaller form factor. USB and Ethernet ports give flexibility for managing programming, operation, and data logging.
Exclusive P-200 Programmer/Controller:
User-friendly touch-screen operation on a benchtop chamber
Three different ‘constant mode’ settings can be stored
Eight cycling programs can be saved, with up to 99 steps each
Select options for the end-of-test modes
The trend-graph display shows a record of setpoints and actual values
Also included is Web Manager remote monitor/control via Ethernet/browser
USB port for upload/download of test profiles and test data
Test programs can uploaded or downloaded from the P-200 via USB thumb drive.
Pattern Manager Lite PC software for program editing and datalog viewing/exporting, to support USB functionality
Downloaded data in secure format can be converted to CSV or displayed.
Operation data can be downloaded as needed, or continually, to USB
Programs may be written on a PC and uploaded via USB
Accurate, repeatable testing by uploading the same program to multiple chambers.
Create your own back-up archive of programs, and get additional profiles from ESPEC's library.
Web Manager for remote monitoring and control via ethernet
Built-in web server application allows the user to monitor the chamber, set programs, or start/stop operation.
Email alerts for alarms or test completion
Multiple languages are available without changing the P-200's language
P-200 Specification: (N-Instrumentation Family)
Display
Color LCD touch-screen, 4.3 inch diagonal
 Multilingual display in English, Japanese, Chinese (simplified or traditional), or Korean
Control Method
PID (Proportional, Integral, Derivative)
 plus WRTC (Window Reference Trajectory Control)
Operating Modes
 (Indicated in upper left of the display)
REMOTE:? STOP: Chamber off, programmer on
 PROGRAM: Runs selected test profile
 CONSTANT: Runs at set value continually
Program Capacity
40 programs, 99 steps per program
Additional Functions
Quick Access Button
 Information/Accessory icon will blink when information is requiring attention, it provides notifications
 Alarm report lists last 1000 alarms and time occurred
 Time signal relay control (with naming capability)
 High/low limit alarm functions
 Audible alarm with on-screen explanation
 Select option to restart modes after power failure
 Automatic start and stop functions
 Key-lock protection and configuration lock-out
 Service guide and help screens
 Three settable reminder alarms for PM
 Running time meter is integral
 RoHS directive lead-free compliant
Pattern Manager Lite Software
Allows creation, editing, and archive storage of test profiles on a PC
 Test profiles may be uploaded and downloaded to P-200
 Allows viewing and graphing of chamber operation data downloaded via USB
 Operation data may be exported to CSV for use with Excel or other programs

Recommended: Web Controller
The ESPEC Web Controller is an embedded server/software solution for monitoring and programming your chamber via Ethernet. Works with P-300, SCP-220, F4T, & F4 controllers. Included with GL Controller.
 See the brochure 
 Self-install kit for existing units 
 Try the live demo now!
Independent of the controller itself, the Web Controller adds additional capabilities for datalogging, programming, alarm emails, and RESTful API.
